name: More Stairs (quartz tag)
summary: Helper data for the More Stairs tweak: it only defines an item tag grouping the quartz block variants. The stair recipes themselves live in the vanillatweaks minecraft module.

vanilla_changes.change: Tag more_stairs:quartz (quartz block, quartz pillar, chiseled quartz block) is the ingredient set for the overridden quartz stairs recipe; vanilla already accepted the same three blocks.

getting_started: Craft in a normal crafting table (or furnace where noted); recipes appear in the recipe book once the ingredients are held.
editor_notes: No recipes in this namespace. The actual effect (8 stairs per craft) is documented in datapacks__vanillatweaks__minecraft.
